title: Decision note: the work graph component's inputs, layout and skin hook
goal: One short page fixes what the component takes, draws and leaves to its consumer
acceptance: docs/decisions/work-graph.md: plain SVG, no graph library (as docs/decisions/charts.md); the input is generic (nodes with id, label, lane, remaining and actual hours, slack, state, critical flag, link; edges from to), not the coordinator's payload type, so any consumer can feed it

Layout: layers left to right by dependency depth, one row per lane, a pure function; critical edges and nodes are marked by weight and a label, never by colour alone; slack is shown as a bar or number on the node

The component only proposes: it emits a node selection and a reorder request or a refusal; it never saves; which moves are allowed comes from the input (each node lists the nodes it may not pass), not from logic inside the component
A skin hook: a node template slot and CSS parts so a consumer can draw its own look (nerv:F-160's Eva skill tree) from tokens, with the plain look the default
A text list fallback (every node with what it depends on, what it unlocks, slack) is always in the page, shown instead of the drawing on narrow screens and by a toggle
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One decision page, stated; it follows the chart decision (plain SVG, no library). Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
